_comment: Copy to config.json (or use the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable to specify another path). This file contains only database and skill_dir; the rest of the configuration such as LLM goes through environment variables or in-app settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > this file's database. Choose one of two forms: (A) fill in the per-field values below; (B) fill in only database.dsn with a complete connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): delete the database above and use a complete DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the per-field values are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory, containing SKILL.md). Priority: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or delete this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory.
